youtube.title: Where Is Jimmy Hoffa? The 50-Year Mystery, Explained
youtube.description:
On July 30, 1975, former Teamsters president Jimmy Hoffa called his wife from outside a restaurant near Detroit to say he'd been stood up. Then he vanished. This is the full story: how Hoffa built the most powerful union in America, his feud with Robert Kennedy, prison and Nixon's commutation, his last afternoon, and five decades of FBI digs that have found nothing.
